name: fuckwayland overlap (unsupported)
description: Lets wxrandr --unsafe-gnome-overlap place two GNOME monitors so that they share screen area, which Mutter's own configuration API refuses. It does nothing at all until it is called, and it re-checks this build of libmutter before every write. Only GNOME Shell 46 and 50 have been measured; on anything else it refuses. Not needed by any other fuckwayland tool.
